about: Public-transport journeys between consecutive itinerary stops longer than 1.5 km, looked up once (not live) in VBB timetable data via https://v6.vbb.transport.rest (a wrapper of the VBB journey planner). Minutes are door-to-door including walking, for the stated weekday and departure time; they vary by time of day, day of week and service changes. Tempelhofer Feld is routed via its Tempelhofer Damm main entrance (Tor 10). Restaurant Anhalt shares the Deutsches Technikmuseum's location, so its journey is the museum's.
source: VBB Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg timetable data, via v6.vbb.transport.rest
